Choose a case and download its **input package (Handoff)** to rerun the recorded mesh and settings, or its **result package** to inspect saved results. This page brings the cases, downloads and usage instructions together.

::: {.callout-note title="Download status"}
The `v1.0.0` packages are being prepared. Each table's Download column will link to the corresponding release when published. For now, review the cases and instructions; these assets are not yet available on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/releases).
:::

## Download and verify

1. Once published, use the table's Download column to open the corresponding release and select that case's input or result package.
2. Download the selected archive and `SHA256SUMS`. If the archive is split, download every numbered part.
3. Verify the files before extracting them:

```bash
sha256sum --ignore-missing -c SHA256SUMS
```

Check: each downloaded asset reports `OK`. Keep the extracted directory structure and original receipts together.

| Package | Purpose and contents |
| --- | --- |
| Input | Rerun the simulation: recorded mesh or AEDT project/specification, numerical settings, model mapping, execution entry point and version instructions. |
| Result | Analyze saved results: retained outputs and available fields, original receipts and file inventory. |

## Rerun or analyze

**Rerun:** use the PDK, SCGSim, solver versions and commands recorded in the package, in a fresh execution copy. Preserve the original mesh; regenerating it from a newer factory is a different experiment.

Original records retain host names and local paths. In the execution copy, adjust the executable and environment-setup paths to your installation before using the runner. Keep the preserved result copy separate, because a runner may replace its outputs.

**Analyze:** use the result package and the [matching tutorial's](notebooks.qmd) result reader. Palace field visualization requires the saved mesh and field files. Saved-field evaluation in AEDT requires a compatible licensed AEDT installation; reading exported CSV tables does not require another solve.

An interrupted run can retain usable intermediate output. Profiling a newer solver with the same inputs is a new run; retain the original result for comparison.
